# immich_server_version (Data Source)

Retrieve the Immich server's current version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "immich_server_version" "version" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `major` (Number) Major version number.
- `minor` (Number) Minor version number.
- `patch` (Number) Patch version number.
- `prerelease` (Number) Pre-release version number.
